title: limonium vulgare subsp. behen
intro: Limonium vulgare subsp. behen, commonly known as sea lavender or sea pinks, is a plant species in the plumbaginaceae family. It is known for its potential health benefits, which include reducing inflammation and improving digestion, as well as its therapeutic actions of calming and soothing the nervous system. The bioactive constituents of sea lavender include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and volatile oils, which are responsible for its medicinal properties. Additionally, sea lavender has been traditionally used to treat various health issues, including insomnia and anxiety, due to its sedative and calming effects.
